newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes mixed in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes mixed in slow trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed in slow trading as players were still unsure of the market trend, dealers said.
"There was still a lack of participation from overseas," a dealer said, adding that most players were refused to take positions on speculation of lower prices because of ample supplies in the market.
The dealer said that there were some latex enquiries from European buyers with drum latex quoting at 236 to 240 cents.
The steadiness in Tokyo also partially helped sentiment.
Trading was cautious with the market waiting for more enquiries from consumers, particularly from Asia.
At the close, November RSS 1 buyer rose a cent to 313.50 cents ($1.25) a kg but November SMR 20 buyer fell half a cent to 308 cents.
The INRO five-day average was 242.47 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Oct 1 from 243.31 on Sept 30. The daily indicator was 241.58 against 241.75. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5015 ringgit)
